headline: Metro 1.4.0 is live: multiples dated opening day / year-ends / build date, Line D drawn only where construction has started (both dates verified, unchanged), and a full Czech section on the same page.

shipped.title: Metro 1.4.0: Pavol's picks of 30 Oct (multiples dates, Line D started sections only, Czech section)
shipped.live_checked: 2026-10-30 at 390 px on https://metro.dravec.org: multiples first in the Timeline panel with dates 1974-05-09, 1980/1990/2000/2010-12-31, 2026-10-30 and counts 9/22/38/47/54/58; 4 Line D segments, no Libuš/Písnice/Depo Písnice, no 'planned' legend row; Ryšánka detail lists both sections with dates and sources; #history-cs is lang=cs; scrollWidth 390; sitemap lastmod 2026-10-30.

decisions.question: Small multiples: where are they now?
options: Leave them; already at the top of the Timeline panel
decisions.default_taken: Left in place (they were already the first child of the Timeline panel since 1.3.0); a 390 px test now holds them above the first event.
decisions.why: The pick was already met; moving nothing is the smallest change.

decisions.question: What exactly is 'the build date'?
decisions.default_taken: Europe/Prague calendar date, stamped into index.html by a Vite transformIndexHtml plugin; an unbuilt file falls back to the viewer's date.
decisions.why: Prague product; a Cloudflare build just after midnight UTC would otherwise be a day early. One line in vite.config.ts to change.

decisions.question: The landing view uses the viewer's local date; should the Today tile count as current there?
options: Only when the shown date equals the build date
decisions.why: Data can't change after the build, so the network is identical; the landing view's local-date behaviour (1.2.1) is untouched.

decisions.question: Line D start dates: are 21 Apr 2022 and June 2026 right, and which day in June?
decisions.default_taken: Kept both. 21 Apr 2022: ČTK's same-day report of DPP's ceremonial start (DPP's Metro D page gives no date). 19 Jun 2026: ČT24 article of that day (ceremony that Friday), confirmed by DPP's 18 Sep 2026 press release ('almost exactly three months since construction began').
decisions.why: Both dates match the sources; nothing needed correcting. No DPP page states either exact day, so each section cites a source that does, plus DPP for 2026.

decisions.question: What does 'draw nothing' cover for sections without a construction start?
options: Remove dotted lines, their station markers and their faint 'not yet built' ghost lines
decisions.default_taken: All three removed; the station list stays in the data (the text still names the planned route).
decisions.why: Literal reading of 'draw nothing'; data kept so restoring is a one-line change.

decisions.question: How to keep the Czech section consistent with structured data and the sitemap?
options: Same URL: inLanguage [en, cs], Czech FAQ entries, og:locale:alternate, sitemap unchanged but lastmod
decisions.default_taken: Same URL; four Czech FAQ answers with inLanguage cs, each fact tested against the visible Czech text; no hreflang (one URL).
decisions.why: Matches the pick (same page); tests stop the Czech text, FAQ and data drifting apart.

decisions.question: How do Czech readers find the section?
decisions.default_taken: Header link (lang=cs, 44 px tap height) jumping to #history-cs.
decisions.why: Without it a Czech reader has to scroll past the whole English text; easy to remove.

decisions.question: Metrics for each change (existing taxonomy only)
decisions.default_taken: decade_jump gains date; line_d_detail {station, sections}; czech_section_view {via: link|scroll}, once per page load.
decisions.why: All ride key_action; no new event names.

decisions.question: Independent review findings
decisions.default_taken: Fixed two before merge: 19 Jun 2026 now cites a source that states the day; history tables fit a 320 px phone (main already overflowed by 21 px). Left one: a viewer west of Prague, just after a build near Prague midnight, sees the Today tile one day ahead of their local today (no visible effect).
decisions.why: Reviewer (fresh subagent, diff + goal only) found nothing blocking.

proposals.recommendation: Update it from the hub session; this session's GitHub scope is Chartres/metro only, so I didn't touch it.

Keep them only in the station detail
